insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room category is specified in the Policy Schedule; Single Private Room is defined as the base single-occupancy room. An optional 'Room Category Select' add-on (C6) can change the entitlement. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room is chosen.

icu.display: No cap (proportionate deduction not applicable for ICU)
icu.note: Policy explicitly states proportionate deductions are not applicable for ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the base policy wording. Aggregate Deductible is an optional cost-sharing cover (C7).

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise monetary sub-limits found in the policy wording. Claims assessed at Reasonable & Customary charges up to Sum Insured.

deductible.note: Aggregate Deductible is an optional cover (C7) chosen for a premium discount; not inbuilt.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credits from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified diseases/procedures (e.g. cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) excluded for 24 months. Accidents exempt.

maternity.note: Maternity Care (C2) is an optional cover with a 2-year waiting period; covers delivery, newborn complications, and first-year vaccinations. Limit as per Policy Schedule. Waiting period reducible to 1 year via optional C3 add-on.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of SI. Reduces by 50% of SI after a claim year. Alternative option: discount on renewal premium instead of bonus.

restoration.note: Restore Infinity Plus (B9) is inbuilt. Restores base SI unlimited times per year. Not available for the first claim in a policy year. Cannot be used for covers with SI over and above base SI. Unutilized restored SI cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days before admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for up to 90 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered under B4 for any procedure requiring less than 24 hrs due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered (B6) if treatment exceeds 3 consecutive days and patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient and day-care treatment covered (B7) including pre/post hospitalisation of 90 days each. Assessed per AYUSH insurance guidelines.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered (B5) when recipient is the insured and claim is admitted under B1.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered (B8) within 50 km radius for emergency, planned, inter-hospital transfers. No explicit rupee cap stated; subject to Reasonable & Customary charges.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment methods listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered under inpatient/day-care benefits.

consumables.note: Consumables Benefit (C1) is an optional cover on additional premium. Without it, consumables are excluded per Annexure I List I.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states claims are only covered within India and payments made in Indian Rupees within India.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document.

portability.note: Portability allowed per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Sleep apnoea, growth hormone therapy, external congenital anomalies, immunoglobulin infusion admissions, STDs, health check-ups, dental (non-accident), hearing aids, alopecia

optional_riders.display: Consumables Benefit, Maternity Care, Maternity Waiting Period Reduction (1yr), Infinite Advantage (unlimited SI for 1 lifetime claim), Early Access (multi-year SI pooling), Room Category Select, Aggregate Deductible
